title: Prioritize the first ten minutes over new feature breadth
recommendation: Instrument and test one-click onboarding before remote multiplayer or more character modes.
rationale: The core experience is functional, but first-session activation and meaningful-session completion are not measured.
expected_impact: Establishes whether users reach value and where they hesitate.
cost: Low engineering effort; five observed user sessions.

title: Commission one flagship Nyra character-art package
recommendation: Wait until the first-ten-minutes test passes, then commission one reusable layered character rather than five models.
rationale: Professional character art could improve desire and sharing, but it should not mask an unproven conversation loop.
expected_impact: Raises perceived quality and gives the product a recognizable flagship character.
cost: External art spend; exact quote required.

title: Keep V0.1 proposal-only for external side effects
recommendation: Allow read, analysis, specs, tests, issues, PRs, and previews; require approval for production and public actions.
rationale: The approval and audit system needs evidence before broader autonomy is safe or useful.
expected_impact: Creates trust while still removing operational work from the founder.
cost: Slower automation initially; much lower downside risk.
